0022600088.text: Toronto hosts Chicago in a game that opens both teams' 2026-27 seasons, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Raptors a 75% win chance. Brandon Ingram is out after Achilles surgery, and Toronto's Chucky Hepburn (hamstring), Immanuel Quickley, Jakob Poeltl, Kawhi Leonard, RJ Barrett, and Scottie Barnes (all rest), and Nate Bittle (foot) are listed as day-to-day, while Chicago's Nic Claxton (hamstring) is also day-to-day. The Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
